editorial.meta_description: The ACP Security Professional exam was retired on 2025-03-31 and currently has no successor exam available for candidates to pursue through Alibaba Cloud.
editorial.overview: The ACP Security Professional certification, managed by Alibaba Cloud, focused on security architecture, threat detection, compliance, IAM, and security operations. This exam is retired as of 2025-03-31. There is no official successor exam provided by the certifying body. Candidates seeking to validate their cloud security expertise should monitor the official Alibaba Cloud certification portal for updates on current professional-level offerings and training paths to ensure they remain aligned with industry standards and requirements.
editorial.who_should_take: This retired exam targeted architects, developers, and operations personnel responsible for managing security products and cloud resources. It required practical experience with Alibaba Cloud security, monitoring, and management tools to address infrastructure requirements and maintain protection for enterprise-level cloud deployments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Since this exam is retired and lacks a successor, do not prepare for it. Focus your efforts on current Alibaba Cloud documentation and security whitepapers. Review the latest product guides for Security Center, RAM, and Cloud Firewall to maintain relevant skills. Consult the official Alibaba Cloud Academy portal to identify active certifications that align with your professional goals and current cloud security standards. Always prioritize learning paths that are currently supported by the vendor to ensure your knowledge remains applicable to modern cloud environments.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the design and implementation of secure cloud architectures using Alibaba Cloud services, focusing on the principles required to build protected and scalable infrastructure environments for various business applications and diverse enterprise workloads.

This domain focuses on identifying, analyzing, and responding to security threats within the cloud environment, ensuring that administrators can effectively detect malicious activities and mitigate potential risks before they impact business operations or data integrity.

This domain addresses the alignment of cloud deployments with regulatory and organizational security requirements, ensuring that all infrastructure configurations adhere to necessary compliance standards and internal governance policies for data protection and privacy within the cloud.

This domain covers the management of user identities, permissions, and access control policies, emphasizing the importance of the principle of least privilege when configuring access to sensitive cloud resources and administrative management consoles for authorized users.

This domain involves the day-to-day operational tasks required to maintain a secure cloud environment, including the continuous monitoring of system logs and the execution of incident response procedures to maintain high availability and system performance.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: As the ACP Security Professional exam is retired, it cannot be scheduled or taken. Please visit the official Alibaba Cloud certification website to explore currently available exams and their respective registration and testing procedures, as the previous testing window has closed permanently for all candidates.

faq.question_title: How many questions were on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consisted of 70 questions in total. These questions were designed to test the candidate's practical knowledge of security architecture and threat management within the Alibaba Cloud ecosystem during the active period of the certification program.

The exam used a pass/fail scale, and the specific passing threshold was not publicly disclosed by the certifying body. Candidates were expected to demonstrate knowledge across all domains to achieve a successful result on the assessment during the active period.

The exam was a 120-minute, linear, computer-based test. Candidates were required to manage their time effectively across the various sections to ensure all questions were addressed within the allotted duration provided for the professional-level certification assessment.

The certification had a validity period of 3 years, after which renewal was required to maintain status. However, because the exam itself is now retired, no new certifications are being issued, and existing holders should check their status.

methodology.summary: This page was compiled by reviewing official Alibaba Cloud documentation, certification announcements, and exam guides to provide accurate information regarding the retirement of the ACP Security Professional exam. All data points were verified against official vendor resources to ensure accuracy.
